{{Top}} {{Conjecture}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:That_elusive_Rebel_MP.png]] |name=Unidentified Rebel MP |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' |gender= |pronouns=new |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin=[[Light]] |cyber= |families=new |parents=new |partners=new |siblings=new |children=new |affiliation=[[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] |masters= |apprentices= }} An '''unidentified human''' served in the [[Alliance Military]] at the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War]]. After [[Jyn Erso]] was [[Liberation of Erso|freed]] from [[Imperial Detention Center & Labor Camp LEG-817|Imperial captivity]] by [[Extraction Team Bravo]], the Rebel lead her through the [[Great Temple]] to bring her before the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] leaders. They wore the uniform of a [[Rebel sentry]]. On their [[helmet]] were the letters "MP" written in the alternate [[Aurebesh]] font [[Domabesh]]; while the letter G, written in the same font, was printed on their shirt. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Walk_walk_walk.png|thumb|left|The rebel walking Jyn Erso (seen on the far left) through the Great Temple]] {{Quote|Glad to say im

[sic]|date=2017-01-19|archivedate=20221007210440}}}} This Rebel MP appeared in the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' and was portrayed by [[Bronson Webb]], who spent eleven days filming his part, although even he has admitted that the character is hard to spot in the final product. ==Appearances== *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Alliance Military members]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
